title: The core, answered
summary: A Giga split on graphite, with the left column echoing the hero: a red-square label, a four-line two-voice statement at 96px, the 48×2 red rule, the lede and both doors. On the right, six 28px wide strips carry a toggle drawn from the real three-piece Kelwin mark. Closed strips hold a ghost of the mark with an empty core slot, and opening an answer lights the plates and lands the red core, so reading an answer installs it. Today's version is a generic full-width accordion with red Q·01 indices and +/× toggles.

reference.borrowed: The asymmetric dark split. A tiny square-dot label and a two-line heading sit at top-left with one quiet 'still have questions? talk to our team' line under it, and the rest of that column is left deliberately empty. A hairline accordion fills the right half with the first row open in muted body text, with no boxes, cards or icons.
reference.kelwin: Giga's light heading became the founder's section-head DNA. The label is a red-square tracked-caps '■ QUESTIONS' with a mono count at right. The statement is wide 96px over four lines ('Straight / answers,' at weight 430, then 'before / the call.' at weight 300 in --fg-2), followed by the 48×2 red rule and a 20px lede. Giga's 'Talk to our team' line became both doors: the red tracked-caps 'REQUEST A SYSTEM AUDIT ↗' and, under it, 'Something we didn't cover? ASK THE FOUNDING TEAM →'. The accordion moved to cols 6–12 as A's hairline strips with a mono 01–06 index and 28px wide questions (A's H3 spec). Giga's chevrons became a 28px glyph of the real three-piece mark (152-unit master). Closed strips show K1 and K2 as a ghost in --line with a hairline slot for the core. On the open strip the plates light to --fg and the red K3 core drops into the slot, the only red inside the list.

motion: entrance (≈1.9s): the act opens on a hard cut from the paper before/after act, and the label row fades (300ms). The four statement lines rise out of masks (800ms --ease-out, 120ms stagger), with the light clause landing 200ms behind the medium one. The red rule draws (500ms), then the lede and the doors fade up 12px (600ms). Strip hairlines draw left to right, top-down (700ms, 120ms stagger), with index, question and glyph fading in behind each one. Strip 01's answer fades up and its red core lands last (400ms at ≈1.5s): the 'installed' beat.

state change (the one orchestrated moment, at 2.4s): the System Audit takes over. Strip 01 folds while strip 02 unfolds (height 900ms --ease-inout, opacity 600ms). 01's core lifts out (240ms) and its plates fade back to the ghost; 02's plates light (600ms) and its red core drops into the slot 560ms later (400ms --ease-out). It rests with the audit answer open at about 3.4s.

interaction: the strips are real buttons with aria-expanded, and only one is open at a time (clicking the open strip closes it). Hovering a strip raises its question from --fg-2 to --fg and its ghost plates from --line to --line-2. The audit button deepens to --accent-hover with ↗ moving 2px up-right, and the contact underline turns --fg with → moving 2px.

on the live site: strip 01 is open on arrival and selection follows clicks; the auto-advance to 02 is demo-only. The left column can stay sticky while the strips scroll past. With reduced motion the page shows the resting state, with strip 01 open and its core landed.
notes: Critique pass: brought the head up to the founder's section-head spec (tracked-caps red-square label, 96px statement, 48×2 red rule, tracked-caps doors). The audit door moved out of the Q2 answer into the left column, so both doors are visible in every state, including reduced motion. The closed glyphs were quieted to a ghost so the open strip's mark is the only lit one, and the questions were raised to A's 28px H3 on a wider cols 6–12 field. Copy is the source FAQ's, lightly trimmed (serial commas, one 'which is'). Coherence pass: no top hairline (it follows a paper act — a hard surface cut), padding to A's 112/96 rhythm, 11px label. Direction-coherence pass: A's one section rhythm is 112px top / 96px bottom in the render (160/160 on the live site); the head grammar is the hero's — Mona 500 11px tracked-caps label with an 8px red square (mono FIG. number at right), 96px two-voice statement on the display tokens with exactly one light phrase, 48×2 red rule, 20px lede in cols 1–6 (≤ 50ch, ≤ 3 lines), optional quiet door, and the founder's bottom-right annotation; FIG. numbers run 01–11 in homepage order; segmented controls are 11px tracked caps.
